Fourier products give the all-power Bessel series, non-atomic output proves strict submultiplicativity, and odd-Bessel coefficient ordering gives asymptotic. Self-contained proof and sampled independent quadrature.

value.rationale: Exact worst-case BV stability of repeated circular von Mises smoothing is a natural operator invariant for directional signal processing. Its full-power sharp coefficients, unique halfcircle discontinuity extremizers and strict improvement beyond multiplying single-step constants distinguish it from mean-square statistical smoothing risk and give a precise long-iteration spectral decay benchmark.
